entities.name: Myocilin
observations: The query sequence is strongly homologous to reviewed vertebrate myocilin proteins, including human Q99972, with 75.0% identity, 99.2% query coverage, and E-value 2.53e-268.
The 506-residue sequence has an N-terminal secretion signal, an N-terminal coiled-coil/disordered region, and a C-terminal olfactomedin-like domain spanning approximately residues 245–505.

Myocilin is a secreted glycoprotein implicated in cell adhesion, cell-matrix adhesion, actin cytoskeleton organization, cell migration, Wnt-related signaling, ERBB2/ERBB3 signaling, neurite outgrowth, and trabecular-meshwork fluid outflow.
Reported localization includes endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi, extracellular space/matrix, exosomes, cilium, and context-dependent mitochondrial compartments.
The protein forms N-terminal homodimers and can form higher oligomers; the sequence alone does not establish the exact oligomeric state of this query protein.

entities.name: Olfactomedin-like domain
observations: The query contains a Pfam OLF domain (PF02191.24) at residues 245–505 with i-Evalue 2.1e-94, supporting assignment to the myocilin/olfactomedin protein family.

entities.name: Cell-matrix adhesion
observations: Myocilin homolog annotations support roles in substrate adhesion, spreading, focal-contact formation, and regulation of cell-matrix adhesion.

entities.name: Actin cytoskeleton organization
observations: Myocilin homolog annotations support regulation of stress-fiber assembly and actin cytoskeleton organization through Rho and Wnt-associated signaling.

entities.name: Extracellular matrix
observations: The signal peptide and myocilin homolog annotations support entry into the secretory pathway and occurrence in extracellular space or extracellular matrix; intracellular ER/Golgi retention and exosomal release are also reported.
